title: 第889章 捡尸第888章 阴谋与诡计
lines: 第889章嚣张（二合一，未完）
顾云的声音不高，却字字清晰，如同月湖上拂过的夜风，凉而不寒，却让殿中每个人都听得清清楚楚。
他的目光在在场所有人的身上掠过，嘴角露出一抹意味深长的笑容，随后便收回了视线。
“胡言乱语！我狼族修士向来团结，你这人族，莫不是想要挑拨离间不成？！！”
银天宇勃然大怒，即便场合并不合适依旧选择站出来指摘。
此言一出，殿中气氛骤紧。
二长老阻拦不及，此刻只有面色阴沉，低声喝道：“天宇，坐下。”
“爷爷，他分明就是在——”
“坐下！”
二长老的声音骤然拔高，如同一盆冷水兜头浇下，让银天宇瞬间冷静下来。
少年浑身一震，咬了咬牙，终究还是不情不愿地坐了回去，只是那双狼瞳依旧死死盯着顾云，像一头被铁链拴住的幼狼。
银月妖帝将这一幕尽收眼底，面上不动声色，心中却暗自摇头。
银天宇这般沉不住气的性子，与顾云同处一殿，简直如同稚童与老叟对弈，一招未出便已被人看穿了所有底牌。
他抬手轻叩宝座扶手，将所有人的注意力重新拉回自己身上。
“天宇年轻气盛，殿下不要与他一般见识。”
顾云轻笑一声：“年轻就可以气盛，银月狼族这文化还是颇有意思啊。”
“前辈不必多说了，我的要求也已经明朗。”
“这无意义的宴会如果还要继续下去，那就恕在下不奉陪了。”
少年的一番话语，让殿中好不容易稍霁的气氛再度凝滞。
银天宇刚刚被按下的怒火腾地又窜了起来，却被二长老一个冰冷的眼神死死压住。
银月妖帝面上的笑意也淡了几分：“既然如此，那就请殿下来我寝殿一叙。”
“来人，撤席。”
“早该如此。”
顾云拂袖起身，径自离开。
侍从们鱼贯而入，将案几上的灵茶灵果一一撤去。
殿中众人面面相觑，谁也没想到这场精心准备的接风宴，竟会以这般方式草草收场。
“族长，这顾云未免也太不将我银月狼族放在眼中了。”

Chapter 889 Arrogance (two in one, not finished)
Gu Yun's voice was not high-pitched, but his words were clear, just like the night wind blowing over the Moon Lake. It was cool but not cold, but could be heard clearly by everyone in the palace.
His eyes swept over everyone present, a meaningful smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, and then he looked away.
"Nonsense! We, the wolf monks, have always been united. Are you, the human race, trying to sow discord?!!"
Yin Tianyu was furious, and even though the situation was inappropriate, he still chose to stand up and criticize.
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere in the palace suddenly became tense.
The second elder was unable to stop him. At this moment, he only looked gloomy and shouted in a low voice: "Tianyu, sit down."
"Grandpa, he is clearly--"
"Sit down!"
The second elder's voice suddenly rose, like a basin of cold water pouring down his head, making Yin Tianyu calm down instantly.
The young man was shocked, gritted his teeth, and finally sat back reluctantly, but his wolf eyes were still staring at Gu Yun, like a young wolf tied by an iron chain.
Silver Moon Demon Emperor took in all this scene, his face remained calm, but he shook his head secretly in his heart.
Yin Tianyu has such an impatient temper, and being in the same room as Gu Yun is like a child playing chess with an old man. All the trump cards have been seen through before he even makes a move.
He raised his hand and tapped the armrest of the throne, drawing everyone's attention back to himself.
"Tianyu is young and energetic. Your Highness, please don't be the same as him."
Gu Yun chuckled: "You can be energetic when you are young. The culture of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan is quite interesting."
"Senior, there is no need to say more, my request is already clear."
"If this meaningless banquet continues, then I will forgive you for not accompanying me."
The young man's words caused the atmosphere in the palace to calm down again.
Yin Tianyu's anger, which had just been suppressed, surged up again, but was suppressed by the cold eyes of the second elder.
The smile on the Silver Moon Demon Emperor's face also faded a bit: "In that case, please come to my dormitory to have a talk, Your Highness."
"Come, please withdraw."
"It should have been so long ago."
Gu Yun stood up and walked away.
The attendants filed in and removed the spiritual tea and spiritual fruits on the table one by one.
Everyone in the hall looked at each other, no one expected that this carefully prepared banquet would end in such a hasty manner.
"Clan leader, this Gu Yun really doesn't take our Silver Moon Wolf Clan seriously."
